issues.t: Front strut towers rust through (recall)
issues.sym: Creaking or clunking from the front over bumps, steering that feels different, or heavy rust where the front struts bolt to the body.
issues.why: Salt and moisture can corrode the strut tower area until it weakens or cracks. Nissan recalled trucks sold or registered in road-salt states for inspection and repair.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the strut towers inspected before more driving, especially on a salt-belt truck. Badly rusted towers can affect steering control.

issues.t: Fuel gauge bounces or reads wrong
issues.sym: The fuel gauge jumps around, reads full or empty when it is not, or the truck runs out of gas with the needle above empty.
issues.why: The fuel level sending unit inside the tank is a known weak part on trucks with the 3.3L V6, and Nissan offered extended coverage on it at one time.
issues.next: Track mileage between fill-ups so you do not run dry, and have the sending unit tested and replaced.

issues.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator - do not drive if unrepaired
issues.sym: Usually no warning sign at all. The danger is that the passenger airbag can burst violently in a crash.
issues.why: The original and some replacement passenger airbag inflators can degrade with age and heat and may rupture, throwing metal pieces. Nissan and NHTSA told owners of unrepaired trucks to stop driving them.
issues.next: Do not drive the truck until a VIN recall check shows the airbag has been replaced. Nissan dealers do the repair free and can arrange a tow.

issues.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the transmission
issues.sym: The transmission shudders, slips or shifts erratically. Transmission fluid looks pink and milky, and the coolant tank may look creamy.
issues.why: The automatic transmission's fluid cooler is built into the radiator. When the radiator fails inside, coolant mixes with transmission fluid and destroys the transmission's clutches.
issues.next: If you see milky fluid, stop driving and have the radiator and transmission checked right away. On a truck with the original radiator, many owners replace it or add a separate transmission cooler before it fails.

issues.t: Timing chain whine from worn guides
issues.sym: A whine or buzz from the engine that rises with RPM, sometimes followed by a check engine light, misfires or a rough idle.
issues.why: The upper timing chain can wear into its plastic tensioner shoe and guides. Nissan later changed the chain and tensioner design.
issues.next: Have the noise checked soon. Replacing worn guides and tensioners early avoids a much larger repair if the chain jumps time.

issues.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong
issues.sym: The gauge sticks after a fill-up, reads higher than the actual fuel left, or the truck runs out of gas with the needle above empty.
issues.why: The fuel level sender in the tank can fail, and on some 2006 and 2008 trucks a recall corrected a gauge that could show fuel left when the tank was empty.
issues.next: Track mileage between fill-ups until it is fixed. Check your VIN for open recalls and have the sending unit tested.

issues.t: Engine relay can cause stalling or no-start (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls while driving or cranks but will not start, sometimes on and off.
issues.why: A relay in the under-hood power distribution module can fail and cut power to the engine controls. Nissan recalled these trucks to fix it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If the truck stalls or will not start, have the relay and power module checked before driving it again.

issues.t: Front crash sensor can rust (recall)
issues.sym: An airbag warning light may come on, or there may be no sign at all.
issues.why: In road-salt states the front crash zone sensor can corrode, which can keep the front airbags from deploying correctly in a crash. Nissan recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the sensor inspected. Do not ignore an airbag warning light.

issues.t: Driver airbag emblem can come loose (recall)
issues.sym: A crack in the Nissan emblem on the steering wheel pad, or an emblem that feels loose.
issues.why: The emblem on the driver airbag cover can crack and break free when the airbag deploys, and could hit the driver. Nissan recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the airbag cover or emblem replaced.

issues.t: Weak welds on rear lower control link (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, a wandering feel, or no warning before a link breaks.
issues.why: Welds on a rear suspension lower link may not have been made properly and could crack, which can affect handling. Nissan recalled some 2010 trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the rear links inspected before regular driving.

issues.t: CVT judder, hesitation and power loss
issues.sym: Shaking when you accelerate gently, a delay before the truck moves, slipping, whining, or a sudden loss of power on the road.
issues.why: Early fourth-generation Pathfinders had many complaints about the continuously variable transmission. Nissan issued bulletins with software updates, valve body replacement and, in some cases, a new transmission.
issues.next: Have a Nissan dealer check for software updates and remaining coverage on your VIN. If the truck loses power or slips, get it inspected before more highway driving.

issues.t: CVT cooler hose can come off (recall)
issues.sym: Transmission fluid dripping under the front, a burning smell, or slipping and loss of drive.
issues.why: On some early-build 2013 trucks a CVT oil cooler hose was not secured well and could come off, leaking fluid that can catch fire on hot parts. Nissan recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. If you see fluid leaking or smell burning, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.t: CVT problems covered by extended warranty
issues.sym: Judder, hesitation, whining, or a flashing warning with reduced power.
issues.why: Nissan extended the CVT powertrain warranty on these years because of transmission problems.
issues.next: Ask a Nissan dealer whether your VIN still has extended CVT coverage, and change CVT fluid on a regular schedule with Nissan's specified fluid.

issues.t: Transfer case seal leak on AWD models
issues.sym: Oily drips near the front passenger side, a humming or whine that grows with speed, or AWD warnings.
issues.why: The seal where the right front axle shaft enters the transfer case can leak. Nissan issued a service bulletin for it. Running low on fluid can wear out the transfer case.
issues.next: Have the leak confirmed and the seal replaced early, and check the transfer case fluid level whenever you see drips under the front.

issues.t: Hood secondary latch may not hold (recall)
issues.sym: The hood flutters or pops up while driving, or it does not catch fully when closed.
issues.why: The hood release cable or a corroded secondary latch can leave the backup latch open. If the main latch also releases, the hood can fly open and block the view. Nissan issued recalls on these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Make sure the hood is fully latched before driving and have the latch serviced.

issues.t: Brake lights stay on or misbehave (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights stay lit with your foot off the pedal, or other drivers tell you your brake lights are not working right.
issues.why: A brake light relay could stick on, and on some trucks the brake light switch was installed wrong. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the brake light switch and relay checked. Steady brake lights can confuse drivers behind you.

issues.t: Front brake torque members may crack (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or grinding from the front brakes, or a pull when braking.
issues.why: Some brackets that hold the front brake calipers could crack, which can affect braking. Nissan recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the front brakes inspected before regular driving.

issues.t: ABS software can lengthen stops on rough roads (recall)
issues.sym: On bumpy or washboard pavement, the truck takes longer to stop than you expect.
issues.why: The anti-lock brake control software could react to rough surfaces in a way that reduced braking force. Nissan recalled these trucks to reprogram it.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the ABS software updated. Leave extra stopping distance until it is done.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may turn off with an adult seated (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag off light stays on with an adult in the front seat.
issues.why: The occupant sensing system could misread an adult as an empty seat or a child and switch the passenger airbag off. Nissan issued recalls for software and sensor fixes.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Until repaired, keep the front seat empty if the airbag off light is on with an adult seated.

issues.t: Hybrid system can shut off while driving (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights come on and the truck loses drive power while moving.
issues.why: Hybrid control software could shut down the powertrain under certain conditions. Nissan recalled hybrid models for a software update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get the software updated before regular driving.

issues.t: ABS unit can leak and short out (recall)
issues.sym: The ABS warning light stays on after you start the truck, or you notice a burning smell.
issues.why: Brake fluid can leak onto the ABS pump's circuit board and short it out, which can start a fire even when the truck is parked and off. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away. If the ABS light stays on after startup, park outside away from buildings until it is repaired.

issues.t: 9-speed automatic rough or delayed shifts
issues.sym: A noticeable bump on the 1-2 shift when cold, lurching on downshifts, surging while coasting, or hesitation when you press the gas.
issues.why: The 9-speed automatic in the newest Pathfinder draws complaints about shift quality. Nissan issued a bulletin to reprogram the transmission computer on 2022 trucks, and some owners report brief power loss that needs closer diagnosis.
issues.next: Ask a Nissan dealer to check for transmission software updates. If the truck drops into neutral or loses power on the road, have it inspected before relying on it.

issues.t: Hood secondary latch welds may fail (recall)
issues.sym: The hood may not stay latched or can lift while driving.
issues.why: Welds on the secondary hood latch bracket may not hold, so the backup latch might not keep the hood down if the main latch lets go. Nissan recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and confirm the hood is fully latched before driving.

issues.t: Third-row headrests may not lock (recall)
issues.sym: Third-row head restraints move freely or come off.
issues.why: The third-row head restraints may not lock in place, so they would not protect passengers well in a rear crash. Nissan recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the headrests fixed before carrying third-row passengers.

issues.t: Driver power seat may not be secured (recall)
issues.sym: The driver's seat rocks, clunks or feels loose.
issues.why: On some trucks the driver's power seat was not fastened to its frame correctly, so it may not hold in a crash. Nissan recalled these trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the seat inspected before regular driving.

issues.t: Driver lap belt pretensioner may be missing a rivet (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom. The problem shows up only in a crash.
issues.why: A rivet may be missing from the driver lap belt pretensioner, so the belt may not hold the driver properly in a crash. Nissan recalled some 2024 trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get it repaired promptly.

issues.t: Front brake calipers may break (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding or clunking from the front brakes, a pull to one side, or weaker braking.
issues.why: Some front brake calipers may have been made with a defect that can let them crack, reducing braking. Nissan recalled affected trucks.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls right away and have the front brakes inspected before more driving.

issues.t: Carpet padding can trap the foot under the brake pedal (recall)
issues.sym: Your right foot catches on thick carpet beside the pedals when you move it to the brake.
issues.why: Thick carpet padding on the transmission tunnel can trap the driver's foot under the brake pedal. Nissan recalled these trucks to remove the padding.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall right away. If your foot ever catches near the pedals, have the carpet area looked at before driving again.

issues.t: Very heavy steering in extreme cold (recall)
issues.sym: The steering wheel is very hard to turn in severe sub-zero weather.
issues.why: The grease in the steering transfer gear thickens in extreme cold. Nissan recalled these trucks to fit a gear with a different lubricant.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall, and have the steering checked if it gets stiff in deep cold.

issues.t: Fuel filler tube can rust through (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell or fuel dripping near the rear wheel while filling up.
issues.why: The filler tube was not coated well enough where a bracket holds it, so it can rust until it leaks during refueling. Leaking fuel is a fire risk.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. Stop refueling and have the tube replaced right away if you see or smell fuel.

issues.t: Rear door strut brackets can bend and let the door drop (recall)
issues.sym: The rear door will not stay up or drops without warning, mostly in hot weather.
issues.why: The brackets that hold the rear door gas struts may have been made incorrectly and can bend in high heat, letting a strut come off.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and avoid standing under the open rear door until the brackets are replaced.

issues.t: Oil cooler and filter connector bolt can break (recall)
issues.sym: Oil spots under the engine, an oil pressure warning, or a sudden loss of oil.
issues.why: The bolt that holds the oil cooler and oil filter connector may be too weak and can snap. The engine can then lose oil pressure and seize.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. If the oil light comes on, pull over and shut the engine off right away.

issues.t: Front wheel hubs may crack on two-wheel-drive trucks (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding or humming from a front wheel, or a wobble in the steering.
issues.why: Front hubs on some two-wheel-drive trucks built in mid-2012 were not hardened properly and can wear and crack.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have both front hubs replaced. Stop driving if a front wheel feels loose or noisy.

issues.t: Backup camera image can be left switched off (recall)
issues.sym: No picture on the screen when you shift into Reverse.
issues.why: The camera display settings can be changed so the rear image stays hidden the next time you back up. Nissan recalled these trucks for a software update.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall and have the software updated. Check your mirrors and look behind you until then.
